instruction: Disable the auto-hide tab bar option in Thunderbird settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled dark mode in Thunderbird by navigating hamburger menu -> Settings -> Add-ons and Themes -> Themes -> clicked Enable on Dark theme. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird menus, open Settings, browse Add-ons Manager, interact with UI buttons and checkboxes, scroll through settings pages
metadata.task_rationale: Agent scrolled through Settings > General and saw the 'Auto hide tab bar' checkbox (currently checked). Unchecking a settings checkbox is a related task at similar difficulty.
metadata.explanation: Task requires unchecking 'Auto hide tab bar' in Settings > General > Window Layout. Evaluator checks prefs.js for mail.tabs.autoHide set to false.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches prefs.js from the Thunderbird profile directory, which stores all user preferences
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses user_pref() lines and checks mail.tabs.autoHide against the expected value false using eq method
Expected value is semantically correct: disabling auto-hide tab bar sets mail.tabs.autoHide to false
Postconfig closes Thunderbird before reading prefs.js, ensuring preferences are flushed to disk
The metric correctly receives the rules dict directly (type=rule handling) and accesses rule.get('expect', {}) without incorrect nesting

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
